verdict.rationale: Adyen Risk Management is a payments fraud and risk engine, not an AI agent or LLM host. Plugging external MCP servers into it as a client is outside this product type's role. The documented Adyen MCP server (adyen-risk-docs-17, adyen-risk-probe-4) is server-side, lets external LLM clients drive Adyen, and does not count toward this client-side story.
